Complete Stars777 Teen Patti Game List

Here’s a clear breakdown of the main Teen Patti options and related games that form the heart of the Stars777 Teen Patti Game List.

  1. Classic Teen Patti (3 Patti)

This is the foundation. Three cards are dealt to each player (usually 2–5 players at a table). Hand rankings run from Trail/Three of a Kind (highest) down to High Card. You can play Blind or Seen. Bluffing and reading the table matter a lot. Perfect starting point if you’re new or just want the pure Indian version of the game.

  1. Muflis (Lowball)

The rankings flip completely. The lowest hand wins instead of the highest. A high card can beat a Trail. This variation saves players who keep getting weak cards and forces everyone to rethink strategy. incredibly well-liked in Indian home games and online. 

  1. Joker / Wild Card Teen Patti

Jokers are cards that are deemed wild. Sometimes the dealer reveals a community card and matching ranks become wild. Hands form much more easily, pots grow faster, and the game feels more exciting. Great when you want higher action.

  1. AK47

Named after the famous rifle. All Aces, Kings, 4s and 7s act as wild cards (that’s 16 wilds in a standard deck). Strong hands appear more often and the pace speeds up. One of the most played variations on Indian platforms.

  1. 999

Forget traditional rankings. Your goal is to get as close as possible to 999. Face cards (J, Q, K, 10) usually count as 0, numbered cards keep their face value, and 9s are the strongest. Pure calculation and a completely different feel from classic Teen Patti.

  1. Other Popular Teen Patti Variations

Depending on the current lobby you may also see:

  • Best of Four (dealt four cards, choose the best three)
  • 4x Boot (higher starting stake, bigger pots from the first round)
  • Revolving or Lowest Joker
  • Sudden Death or high-stakes elimination-style tables

These keep the Stars777 Teen Patti Game List interesting so you never get stuck playing only one mode.
